# Close the 2026-07-29 State System content-accuracy gaps so freshness, staleness, report surfaces, evidence grounding, fleet canaries, ECS manifests, and deployed runtime roots reflect real content health rather than only update mechanics. Spec - Drift Anchor

*Generated by PlanForge V2 on 2026-07-29. Session: `20260729-state-content-accuracy`. This is a drift anchor, not a standalone product brief.*

## End State

The State System product repo has a tested live and scheduled content-staleness path, truthful inspect and report surfaces that separate process health from content health, unambiguous connector freshness watermarks, fleet-refresh age canaries, hardened evidence-grounded commit validation, and explicit coverage wiring for Navicyte and ECS manifests. After the product repo passes all tests, validation, report-suite generation, and review gates, deployed roots for LFW, Synthyra, b-state, and Navicyte are updated only as data/config/runtime artifacts using the fixed behavior.

## Acceptance Criteria

- LiveStalenessReviewer and LiveStrategicReviewer no longer raise NotImplementedError for the supported live review path and have unit coverage for success, stale, failed, unknown, and empty-source cases.
- A scheduled or fleet-refresh-integrated staleness runner writes non-empty strategic-staleness read models when review inputs exist and writes explicit gap records when inputs are absent; an empty strategic-staleness projection carries top-level `review_status: no_reviewable_findings` rather than appearing as a healthy review.
- Company understanding surfaces cannot claim all sources are fresh, passed, or ready when instance freshness says stale; they either regenerate on fleet-refresh cadence or carry a hard visible staleness banner.
- Inspect and report surfaces expose process health separately from content health, with tests proving a successful process run can still report stale content.
- Connector freshness records clearly distinguish remote HEAD, local checkout, sync index, remote corpus, probe-only, latest indexed timestamp, and latest observed source timestamp.
- Fleet-refresh emits a report-age canary that fails when expected reports are missing or older than policy, catching dead launchd jobs.
- The commit path honors JSON schema minItems, derives evidence allowlists from the stored review packet, and resolves review_packet_id before accepting a model proposal.
- Navicyte has an explicit refresh path unless a documented operator decision removes the stale satellite from deployed surfaces.
- ECS manifest wiring works beyond b-state for every intended deployed root and has integration coverage.
- All product changes have unit tests; cross-surface behavior has integration tests; deployed-root updates are verified with product CLI commands against each live root.
- Final validation includes unittest discovery, State System validation, report-suite generation, targeted integration tests, git diff check, roborev or equivalent review, commit, pull --rebase, push, and clean status.

## Out Of Scope

- Adding new private corpora or credentials to the product repo.
- Building a new UI beyond existing report and inspect surfaces.
- Changing governance authorization semantics for protected external actions.
- Replacing source-owned indexes with State System-owned raw corpus materialization.

## Speedrift Modules

- coredrift (required): This is Speedrift-managed implementation work with dependency sequencing, validation, and handoff requirements.
- specdrift (required): The work changes state contracts and needs an explicit acceptance anchor for content freshness, review packets, and deployed-root behavior.
- datadrift (required): Schemas, read models, freshness records, manifests, and deployed runtime artifacts are structured data contracts.
- archdrift (required): The plan touches content-health architecture across live review, scheduled refresh, inspection, and deployment boundaries.
- yagnidrift (required): Existing surfaces are being modified and must avoid duplicate staleness systems, stale shells, and dead compatibility code.
- redrift (required): Deployed-root rollout is parity and migration work from product behavior to live runtime roots.
- qadrift (required): The problem is content accuracy, so quality gates must prove truthful reports, stale banners, canaries, and evidence grounding.
- reviewdrift (required): Shared contracts and live-root updates require independent review before closeout.
- agencydrift (recommended): Agency is preferred for specialized review and implementation fallback, but Pi remains the default runtime if Agency is unavailable.
- fixdrift (required): Test, validation, drift, and review failures should create bounded repair tasks instead of silent retries.
- uxdrift (recommended): Existing report and inspect surfaces are human-facing; UX evaluation is scoped to report clarity, banners, and health separation.
- depsdrift (optional): No dependency changes are expected, but pin verification and lockfile drift should run if implementation touches pyproject or uv.lock.
- secdrift (required): Evidence grounding and commit validation are integrity boundaries; bypasses must block rollout.
- debatedrift (recommended): One bounded adversarial review is useful for trying to disprove semantic truthfulness without broadening into open-ended debate.

## Verification

- pre-edit orientation: `wg quickstart && wg agent-guide && git status --short --branch` (pre_edit)
- schema validation: `python3 -m state_system.cli --project-root . validate` (per_task)
- unit suite: `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests` (pre_handoff)
- report suite: `python3 -m state_system.cli --project-root . report-suite-run --output-dir /tmp/state-system-report-suite` (pre_handoff)
- diff hygiene: `git diff --check` (pre_handoff)
- failure diagnosis: `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v` (on_failure)
- live staleness reviewer unit tests: `python3 -m unittest tests.test_live_staleness_reviewer -v` - Cover supported live reviewer outcomes and prove NotImplementedError is gone for implemented paths.
- strategic staleness read model unit tests: `python3 -m unittest tests.test_strategic_staleness_read_model -v` - Prove runner emits real keyed read models and explicit gaps rather than empty shell success artifacts.
- freshness watermark schema tests: `python3 -m unittest tests.test_instance_source_freshness -v` - Validate remote HEAD, local checkout, sync index, remote corpus, probe-only, and timestamp basis semantics.
- commit evidence grounding tests: `python3 -m unittest tests.test_commit_evidence_grounding -v` - Prove minItems is honored, review_packet_id resolves, and evidence refs are allowed only from the stored review packet.
- fleet refresh canary tests: `python3 -m unittest tests.test_fleet_refresh_report_age_canary -v` - Prove missing and over-age reports fail canary checks while fresh reports pass.
- inspect report health separation integration: `python3 -m unittest tests.test_inspect_report_content_health_integration -v` - A successful process run with stale content must render process healthy and content stale without contradiction.
- company understanding stale banner integration: `python3 -m unittest tests.test_company_understanding_staleness_integration -v` - Understanding surfaces regenerate on fleet refresh or show a hard staleness banner when instance freshness is stale.
- ECS multi-root manifest integration: `python3 -m unittest tests.test_ecs_manifest_multi_root -v` - ECS manifest wiring works for b-state and at least one non-b-state fixture or deployed-root-shaped fixture.
- full repository validation: `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests && python3 -m state_system.cli --project-root . validate` - All shipped schemas, examples, and runtime tests pass after product changes.
- report and inspect readability assertions: `python3 -m state_system.cli --project-root . report-suite-run --output-dir /tmp/state-system-report-suite && python3 - <<'PY'
import json, pathlib, sys
root=pathlib.Path('/tmp/state-system-report-suite')
html=(root/'index.html').read_text()
required=['process health','content health','stale','canary']
missing=[t for t in required if t.lower() not in html.lower()]
if missing:
    raise SystemExit('missing report terms: '+', '.join(missing))
PY` - Human-facing and machine-readable report output clearly labels process health, content health, stale banners, source gaps, and report-age canary failures.

## Risks

- The product repo can be made correct while deployed roots remain stale or contradictory. [high]: Deployed-root discovery, rollout, and parity verification are required after product review and before final handoff.
- Report-age canary could be mistaken for content freshness. [high]: Spec and tests require separate process health, content health, and report artifact age fields.
- Schema tightening around minItems or watermark basis may break existing fixtures or live-root records. [medium]: Run product validation, update public fixtures, and perform live-root rollout as data/config migration after product tests pass.
- Navicyte path or desired coverage decision may be ambiguous. [medium]: Default to adding a refresh path; escalate before dropping the satellite or deleting live-root material.
- Pre-existing dirty files may be unrelated and could be accidentally committed. [medium]: Discovery records dirty state; final handoff stages only intentional product changes and excludes private/generated artifacts.
- Model-mediated staleness review could drift into hardcoded semantic classification. [high]: Keep model interpretation in reviewer packet/output boundaries; code validates evidence, persistence, health fields, and scheduling.
- Existing overlapping Workgraph tasks may conflict with this plan if dispatched concurrently. [medium]: The overlap-resolution node must list supersede, block, depend, merge, or unrelated handling before implementation dispatch.
- The validate-runtime command may not exist, causing live-root verification commands to fail if left unchecked. [medium]: Discovery confirms CLI commands and downstream rollout uses documented validate with --state-root unless a dedicated runtime validation command is implemented.
